body: Ever Oasis is Grezzo's Nintendo 3DS action role-playing game about creating a settlement in a world threatened by Chaos. A young Seedling works with the water spirit Esna to establish an oasis and welcome people from the surrounding desert. Exploring distant ruins supplies materials and introduces potential residents. Back home, those discoveries become shops and a larger community. Koichi Ishii, known for his work on Mana, directed an adventure whose two activities support one another: a better settlement helps the next expedition, and the expedition brings something useful home.

Seedling residents can operate Bloom Booths, shops that need materials gathered outside the oasis. Supplying them produces income and helps the settlement develop. Other residents contribute abilities useful during exploration instead of opening a stall. Welcoming somebody therefore changes more than the population count. A new companion may solve a problem in a dungeon, while another shop can create demand for an item found along the route. The town gradually becomes a practical record of the places visited and the people encountered there.

A small party explores the desert and fights directly with weapons, evasive movements and special abilities. The player can switch between companions to use their different tools against enemies or environmental obstacles. Choosing who comes along matters before the group leaves home. Finding materials and completing requests then gives the return journey a purpose beyond reaching safety. Sebastian Schwartz's score accompanies the changing pace between active expeditions and tending the oasis, keeping the refuge at the centre of a world that continually invites another trip outward.
